mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 63 degrees and clear outside Verona City Hall under a Waxing Crescent moon, with no visible space station passes tonight.

In local news, Verona apartment residents can easily compost by dropping off food waste at Badger Prairie. The city is also working to reduce emissions by implementing anti-idling technology on its new ambulance and transitioning streetlights to energy-efficient LEDs.

There are plenty of events coming up, including live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie on July 19th, the Mount Horeb Art Fair, and yoga sessions on July 20th. Plus, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market returns on Wednesday.

According to the weekly police recap, last Friday, July 10th, officers and K9 Drea successfully intercepted illegal drugs and cited a driver for operating with a suspended license during an evening traffic stop.
The delicious Culver's Flavor of the Day is Turtle. The store is currently closed and will open at 10 AM. If you cannot make it today, tomorrow's flavor will be Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Crunch.
